description: The file defines a PHP class KinesisVideoArchivedMediaClient within the AWS SDK, providing methods to interact with Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Archived Media service, including methods for retrieving clips, streaming URLs, images, media fragments, and listing fragments.

classes.name: KinesisVideoArchivedMediaClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Archived Media service in AWS SDK.

methods.name: getClip
methods.description: Retrieves a media clip from the Kinesis Video Stream.

methods.name: getDASHStreamingSessionURL
methods.description: Fetches a DASH streaming session URL for the media.

methods.name: getHLSStreamingSessionURL
methods.description: Fetches an HLS streaming session URL for the media.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Gets images related to the media stream.

methods.name: getMediaForFragmentList
methods.description: Retrieves media for a list of fragments.

methods.name: listFragments
methods.description: Lists available media fragments in the stream.

search-terms: Amazon Kinesis Video Streams Archived Media
